theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid (P + 1))) (k + 1), R'.measure univ ≠ ∞ ∧ (∀ S : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → μHE[k] (R.carrier \ S) = 0 → μHE[k + 1] (R'.carrier \ ((fun p : ℝ × Euclid P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2) : Fin (P + 1) → ℝ) : Euclid (P + 1))) '' (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ S))) = 0) ∧ ∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) (k + 1), Continuous β → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖β y‖ ≤ C) → R'.action β = R.action (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((β (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x) : Fin (P + 1) → ℝ) : Euclid (P + 1))).curryLeft (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin (P + 1)) (1 : ℝ))).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (fun x' : Euclid P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x') : Fin (P + 1) → ℝ) : Euclid (P + 1))) x))
